text.p: Results of rain-affected four-day English county championship matches ending on Monday:

In Worcester: Lancashire beat Worcestershire by three wickets. Worcestershire 100-7 declared and 135-0 declared (T.Curtis 77 not out), Lancashire first innings forfeited and 237-7 (A.Flintoff 70, W.Hegg 54 not out).
At The Oval (London): Surrey beat Nottinghamshire by 131 runs. Surrey 201-9 declared and 123-6 declared, Nottinghamshire 73-1 declared and 120 (I.Salisbury 6-19).
At Headingley (Leeds): Yorkshire v Middlesex - match drawn. Middlesex 150-3 (M.Ramprakash 76 not out) - match abandoned. Yorkshire 4 points, Middlesex 3.
At Leicester: Leicestershire v Warwickshire - match abandoned without play. Leicestershire 3 points, Warwickshire 3.
At Luton: Northamptonshire v Gloucestershire - match drawn. Gloucestershire 180-7 declared (K.Curran 4-69), Northamptonshire 58-6.
